subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun Sep 27 shortlist | Everpure (P) leads a thin, large-cap-tilted week — 5 candidates cleared
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Sunday, September 27, 2026 — Kuwait time · scan through Friday Sep 25 close

Candidates cleared all 4 gates

5 of ~28 raw tickers screened

Thin, large-cap-tilted week. Best setup: Everpure (P) — guidance-beat + 4 analyst target hikes, live-confirmed near its highs. Two live IBKR contradictions caught and dropped (CRWD, META) — see cut list.

📋 Account note (sizing basis, not this run's focus)

Live IBKR right now: net liq $534.50, available cash $432.16, only GOOG (0.3 sh) showing as an open position — SPXC no longer appears in IBKR's live position list, which lines up with today's daily-portfolio-check flagging it as likely already stopped out. portfolio.json is stale (still shows SPXC open, cash $330.60) — that reconciliation is the daily-check routine's job, already flagged there as today's #1 priority. All position sizing here uses the live $534.50 net liq.

Momentum Shortlist

~28 raw tickers surfaced across the Phase 1 scan. 5 cleared all 4 gates (live signal, liquidity/sizing, halal + defense screen, room-to-run). Cap mix: 4 large-cap, 1 small/mid-cap — the small/mid lane came up thin this scan (see note below the cards). Run analyze [TICKER] for the full deep dive on any name.
#1 — P · Everpure Inc-A
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Tech / Data Storage+AI LARGE CAP 		$126.50 +3.79%

Signal: Preliminary FY28 revenue guide of $7.0-7.3B (39-45% growth) vs. $6.2B consensus, triggering four separate sell-side PT hikes in the same window (Morgan Stanley $137, Citi $160 Buy, Wells Fargo $145, Needham $140 initiation) — 2 trading days ago (Sep 24 gap, Sep 25 continuation), still intact.

Why it's interesting: This is the former Pure Storage (rebranded, ticker "P" on IBKR) building AI/hyperscale growth legs onto its enterprise storage base. Four independent analyst upgrades in one week off a guide that beat consensus by ~15% at the midpoint is a real institutional re-rating, not a retail pop — and it's the cleanest "catalyst already behind it" shape this strategy hunts for.

Price: $126.50 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$550M | RS vs SPY: sharply outperforming (SPX ~flat this month)

Realistic near-term target: +4-8% over 3-8 trading days — next resistance is the Sep 24 spike high, with the analyst PT cluster ($137-160) as the extended case

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — fresh 2-day base, not chasing an extended run

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $126.80 · stop-limit trigger $121.80 / limit $121.00 (below the Sep 24-25 base) · TP1 sell limit $131.00 (Sep 24 spike high) · TP2 $137.00 (Morgan Stanley's raised target) · size ~0.63 shares ≈ $80 (~15% of $534.50 net liq) · R:R ≈ 1.0:1 to TP1, ≈ 2.2:1 to TP2

Event window: catalyst already behind it ✅ — no dated event in window  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — enterprise data storage/AI infrastructure  |  Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: fractional shares required at this price — already confirmed enabled on this account (GOOG 0.3sh, prior SPXC 0.5sh both filled). ~$2 round-trip commission on an ~$80 position is a ~2.5% drag to clear before breakeven.

Next step: analyze P
#2 — DELL · Dell Technologies
⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5 Hardware/AI Servers LARGE CAP 		$563.23 +5.08%

Signal: Spiked to a fresh all-time high $595.51 intraday Sep 18 on AI-server-bookings news (Q2 bookings $6.1B, matching the prior three quarters combined), pulled back to a $530-536 base over the following week, then bounced +5.08% Friday off that base.

Why it's interesting: The bounce off a clean weekly base with real volume is more useful than the spike itself — the AI-server-demand thesis is intact and the stock just proved the pullback found buyers.

Price: $563.23 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$4.38B | RS vs SPY: strongly outperforming, sitting 5.4% off its ATH

Realistic near-term target: +4-8% over 5-10 trading days — back toward the Sep 17-18 shelf/ATH

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $545-552 — chasing today's bounce risks more to a sane stop than the near-term reward; the retest of the base has a much better R:R

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $548.00 (fills only on the pullback) · stop-limit trigger $529.00 / limit $526.50 (below the Sep 24 base low $530.45) · TP1 sell limit $588.00 (Sep 17 shelf) · TP2 $595.51 (Sep 18 ATH) · size ~0.146 shares ≈ $80 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 2.1:1 to TP1

Event window: catalyst already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — PC/server hardware  |  Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: fractional required at $563/share — confirmed enabled on this account.

Next step: analyze DELL
#3 — ON · ON Semiconductor
⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5 Semiconductors LARGE CAP 		$77.40 +5.81%

Signal: Broke above its 3-week trading range ($66-77) today on guidance that its AI-data-center revenue will more than double in 2026, growing ~10 points faster than the broader AI-data-center market — live, today, biggest % mover in this scan.

Why it's interesting: A genuine single-day range breakout on a forward-looking business catalyst, not a multi-day parabolic chase — the stock is still 43% below its 52-week high, so this reads as an early recovery leg rather than a blow-off top.

Price: $77.40 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$801M | RS vs SPY: clear standout today vs. the sector

Realistic near-term target: +5-8% over 3-8 trading days — modest by design since it's a bounce off a deep drawdown, not a fresh ATH push

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — fresh breakout day, not extended

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $77.60 · stop-limit trigger $73.30 / limit $72.80 (below the broken range top / Sep 24 close $73.15) · TP1 sell limit $82.00 · TP2 $87.00 (stretch, if the AI-data-center narrative extends) · size ~1.03 shares ≈ $80 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 1.1:1 to TP1

Event window: catalyst already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — semiconductor manufacturer  |  Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: whole shares work fine at this price, no fractional needed.

Next step: analyze ON
#4 — MRNA · Moderna
⭐⭐⭐ 3/5 Biotech/Pharma LARGE CAP 		$197.82 +1.54%

Signal: mRNA melanoma-vaccine data (with Merck) has driven a 5-session, +29% run (Sep 21-25, ~$154 → ~$199), printing a fresh high each day — this is already-happened data, not a future PDUFA/AdCom bet, so it respects the binary-catalyst pause.

Why it's interesting: Real continuation momentum on resolved clinical news, but 5 days of +29% is a genuinely stretched move — this is the textbook "correct thesis, bad entry price" shape.

Price: $197.82 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$3.35B | RS vs SPY: one of the market's strongest 5-day movers

Realistic near-term target: +5-10% from a pullback entry, over 3-8 trading days

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $185-190 — chasing at $198 after a 29% weekly run risks more to a sane stop than the near-term reward

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $188.00 (fills only on the pullback) · stop-limit trigger $179.50 / limit $177.50 (below the Sep 24 low $180.38) · TP1 sell limit $199.00 · TP2 $210.00 (stretch, if continuation holds) · size ~0.43 shares ≈ $80 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 1.3:1 to TP1

Event window: catalyst (trial data) already behind it ✅ — not a dated PDUFA/AdCom bet  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — vaccines/pharma  |  Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: fractional required at $198/share — confirmed enabled on this account.

Next step: analyze MRNA
#5 — CDNA · CareDx
⭐⭐⭐ 3/5 Diagnostics SMALL/MID CAP 		$63.93 +4.17%

Signal: Medicare coverage decision for its AlloSure/AlloMap/AlloSeq transplant-testing systems drove a 2-day, +17% move (Sep 24-25, ~$54 → ~$64), including a $65.19 intraday high today — fresh, 1-2 trading days old.

Why it's interesting: A reimbursement decision is a durable revenue-model catalyst, not sentiment — but two days of +17% already priced in a lot of the good news.

Price: $63.93 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$75.9M (thinner, but workable at this position size) | RS vs SPY: sharply outperforming

Realistic near-term target: +5-8% from a pullback entry, over 3-6 trading days

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $60-61 — today's intraday low held as support, but chasing the close after a 2-day 17% pop has a poor near-term R:R

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $60.80 (fills only on the pullback) · stop-limit trigger $58.80 / limit $58.20 (below today's intraday low $60.51) · TP1 sell limit $65.19 (today's high) · size ~1.32 shares ≈ $80 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 1.9:1 to TP1

Event window: catalyst already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — diagnostics/lab testing  |  Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: fractional required at $64/share — confirmed enabled. This is the lone small/mid-cap survivor this scan (see note below).

Next step: analyze CDNA

Cap-size mix, stated plainly: 4 large-cap, 1 small/mid-cap. The small/mid lane wasn't skipped — it came up thin on live confirmation. ICHR (real Sep 21 upgrade) is still 49% off its 52-week high on a weak day; CPRI's "upgrade" narrative was misdated (Aug 2025); AUGO and SSRM's momentum stats are YTD, not a live trigger; GSIT's catalyst is a defense-contract award. CDNA is the one small/mid name that actually cleared live confirmation this scan.

🏆 Today's Best Setup

P (Everpure) — a guidance beat wide enough to pull four separate analyst price-target hikes in the same week, on a name only 3.7% off its 52-week high right now. It's the cleanest version of this strategy's favorite shape: the catalyst (guidance/upgrades) is already behind it, liquidity is not a constraint, and the reaction is confirmed live by IBKR, not just by search commentary. Invalidation: a close back below $121.00 — that would mean the guide-beat reaction has fully round-tripped and the thesis is wrong, not just resting.

🗑️ Cut This Run — the analyst's show-of-work

CRWDFADED vs. live data — search said new 52-wk highs (+37.7%/mo), IBKR shows it down -2.68% today. Trust IBKR.
METAFADED vs. live data — search said +12% weekly surge and a $995 PT raise, IBKR shows it down -3.83% today, reversing right off its high.
AKAMFADED — unusual call-sweep flow was real, but IBKR's own daily bar shows an intraday spike to $128.46 that fully round-tripped to close $113.94 at the day's low. Failed breakout, not a signal to chase.
GSITHARD EXCLUDED — the "surge" catalyst is a U.S. Army SBIR contract award. That's a defense-contract play by this skill's own rule, no exception for a non-defense-primary business. Also stale (May 2026 surge, not this week).
SEZLHARAM — Sezzle's BNPL book is financed by a line of credit at 12-16% interest, with "interest margin" as an explicit revenue line. That's interest-based consumer finance at the core, not incidental.
HUMHARAM — Humana's core business is health insurance, i.e. conventional insurance as the primary business.
CPRIStale/no live signal — the analyst-upgrade story search surfaced was misdated (it's from Aug 2025). IBKR shows the stock still 47% off its 52-wk high and flat on the day.
ICHRToo weak — the Sep 21 analyst upgrade is real, but the stock is 49% off its 52-wk high on only a modest +2.6% day. Not "already moving."
AUGO / SSRMNo live trigger — strong YTD "momentum grade" stats, but IBKR shows both flat-to-down today. A backward-looking stat isn't a live signal.
JAKKStale — the price-target raise search surfaced traces to a June 2026 article.
AMDNo active trigger — parked right at its 52-wk high but only +0.26% today. Worth a watch, not a shortlist slot.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. This is a first filter, not a trade — run analyze [TICKER] before entering anything above.
